name: Safety-Gymnasium
description: Safety-Gymnasium is an environment suite designed for safe reinforcement learning, encompassing safety-critical tasks in both single and multi-agent scenarios with vector and vision-only inputs. It includes a library of 16 state-of-the-art SafeRL algorithms to facilitate evaluation and comparison of safety performance in reinforcement learning.
reputation: A widely used safe reinforcement learning benchmark suite that has become a standard successor to Safety-Gym for evaluating constraint-aware RL methods.
notes: Includes both single and multi-agent safety-critical tasks and a comprehensive library of SafeRL algorithms for benchmarking.
